title: Requirement-row guard fires on filled-but-malformed guarantor fields, not just missing ones
detail: Guard matches any guarantor_* error. A required cohort that names a guarantor but mistypes the email (or picks an invalid relationship / non-positive income) gets the 'A guarantor is required' banner row implying no guarantor was given, when one was — just malformed.
recommended_fix: Gate the row on a missing-field check (empty name/phone/email/income/employer) rather than any guarantor_* error, so format errors on filled fields don't surface the requirement statement.
